language_task: set the mushroom on the green cloth
outcome_evidence: In right_shoulder_cam, the mushroom initially lies on the bare tabletop beside the green cloth (frame 0). The robot closes its gripper around it (frames 14–20), lifts and carries it toward the cloth (frames 34–57), and releases it onto the cloth, with the gripper visibly separated above it (frame 58). No failed acquisition, harmful collision, or unintended scene disturbance is established.
